Description
The AeroPure AP-200 circulates room air through a three-stage filter in under ten minutes.
Three fan speeds cover bedrooms, offices and small studios.
Specifications
Coverage 40 sq m, power 45W, voltage 220-240V, weight 4.2 kg.
